documentation.content: An instance's resident memory is above MEMORY_ALERT_MB (default 300 MB of the 384 MB F1/B1 instance). App Engine restarts an instance that exceeds its memory, dropping in-flight requests. Each serving instance checks every minute, and each scheduler tick checks too. Look for a large import or export, or a leak after a recent deploy; move to a larger instance class if it is steady load. Alert name: memory.high.
